summary.desc: Bark from decayed trees still standing in St. Creek

raw.desc: Bark from decayed trees still standing in St. Creek
raw.name: Ashen Bark

dictionary.lore: No living plants or animals can thrive in St. Creek at present. One theory holds that this is due to a certain factor unleashed during St. Creek's destruction. Adherents claim that the trees of St. Creek absorbed a particularly large share of this factor, and some researchers have begun to focus their experiments on the trees' bark. Should their research bear fruit, it could lead to applications for this mysterious factor in other fields, as well as the restoration of St. Creek itself.
